name: sentencetts-reader
description: Firefox extension: read any webpage or PDF aloud with live sentence highlighting using multiple TTS engines

scripts.build: echo 'No build step: the .js files in the repo root ARE the source of truth. After editing them run npm run sync-source, then npm run check.' && node check.js
scripts.verify: node -c background-src.js && node -c build-chrome.js && node -c check.js && node ../tests/run.js
scripts.package: cd .. && rm -f sentencetts-reader.zip && zip -rq sentencetts-reader.zip manifest.json background.js kokoro-worker.js content.js spa-main.js content.css popup.html popup.js popup.css pdfviewer.html pdfviewer.js pdf/ vendor/ icons/ build-source/ -x "build-source/chrome-key.pem" "build-source/manifest.chrome.json" "build-source/build-chrome.js"
scripts.release: npm run verify && npm run package && node check.js
